introduction: This spec makes the hub's git server (internal/gitserver) enforce the single-writer authority that PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE declares for a carry_patch workspace's registered patch branches: refusing or forwarding a direct push in fork-authoritative mode, and offering an opt-in best-effort mirror of accepted pushes to the fork in hub-authoritative mode, without internal/gitserver importing carry-patch code.

glossary.PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE: Workspace variable delivered by 02_fork_authoritative_sync; 'hub' means the hub is the single writer for registered patch branches, 'origin' means the fork is.
glossary.PUSH_PATCHES_TO_ORIGIN: Workspace variable this spec adds; enabled only by the exact string "true", it controls whether the hub's git server forwards (origin mode) or mirrors (hub mode) patch-branch pushes to the fork.
glossary.fork-authoritative mode: The state where a carry_patch workspace's PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE is 'origin'.
glossary.forward: A non-force push of a candidate ref to the fork (origin), performed before the hub's local ref is written, in fork-authoritative mode with PUSH_PATCHES_TO_ORIGIN=true.
glossary.guard candidate: A ref update in an incoming push that is examined by requirements 3-5: a refs/heads/<name> update, not the integration_branch, matching a non-deleted patches row, and not a delete.
glossary.hub-authoritative mode: The state where a carry_patch workspace's PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE is 'hub'.
glossary.integration branch: The workspace's configured integration_branch column value; never a guard candidate even if a patches row shares its name.
glossary.mirror: A best-effort, asynchronous force push of an already-accepted branch update to the fork (origin), performed in hub-authoritative mode with PUSH_PATCHES_TO_ORIGIN=true.
glossary.registered patch branch: A branch whose name matches the branch_name of a row in the patches table.

requirements.title: PUSH_PATCHES_TO_ORIGIN workspace variable
requirements.rationale: The forward/mirror decision must be driven by a live, per-push read of an opt-in variable, matching every other carry-patch on/off variable's fail-open convention.

criteria.condition: a push targets a carry_patch workspace
criteria.action: read PUSH_PATCHES_TO_ORIGIN fresh via GetVariableFunc("workspace", slug, "PUSH_PATCHES_TO_ORIGIN") for that push rather than reusing any previously read value
treat only the exact string "true" as enabling PUSH_PATCHES_TO_ORIGIN, treating an unset variable, an empty string, or any other value as disabled

criteria.condition: the variable store read for PUSH_PATCHES_TO_ORIGIN returns an error
criteria.action: treat PUSH_PATCHES_TO_ORIGIN as disabled for that push and continue evaluating the push under the disabled-forwarding rules
criteria.contract: the push is processed exactly as if PUSH_PATCHES_TO_ORIGIN were absent; the store error is not surfaced to the pushing git client

requirements.title: Guard candidacy classification
requirements.rationale: Requirements 3-5 must only examine the narrow set of ref updates the PRD scopes them to, at no extra cost for anything outside that set.

criteria.action: for any incoming push to a carry_patch workspace, classify a ref update as a guard candidate if and only if its name is refs/heads/<name>, <name> matches the branch_name of a patches row whose status is not 'deleted', <name> is not the workspace's integration_branch, and the update's New hash is not the zero hash

criteria.condition: a pushed ref's name does not have the refs/heads/ prefix (a tag ref or any other namespace)
criteria.action: exclude that ref from guard candidacy without querying the patches table

criteria.condition: a pushed branch name equals the workspace's integration_branch
criteria.action: exclude that ref from guard candidacy even when a patches row shares that branch name

criteria.condition: a pushed branch matches a patches row whose status is 'deleted'
criteria.action: exclude that ref from guard candidacy

criteria.condition: a ref update's New hash is the zero hash
criteria.action: exclude that ref from guard candidacy regardless of the branch's registration status, and accept the delete exactly as before this spec

requirements.title: Refusal in fork-authoritative mode
requirements.rationale: When the fork is the sole writer and forwarding is off, a direct hub push to a registered patch branch must be refused per-ref without disturbing the rest of the push.

criteria.condition: PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE is 'origin', PUSH_PATCHES_TO_ORIGIN is not "true", and a ref update is a guard candidate under 04-REQ-2
criteria.action: reject that ref's update with the per-ref message 'branch is synced from origin; push to <git_url> instead', where <git_url> is the workspace's git_url column, leaving the branch's local ref completely unchanged
criteria.contract: the client's report-status response marks that ref ng with the given message; the ref's SHA in the workspace repository is byte-identical to its value before the push

criteria.action: unpack the incoming packfile and apply every non-rejected ref update normally even when one or more candidate refs in the same push are rejected under 04-REQ-3.1

criteria.condition: a push contains both a candidate ref rejected under 04-REQ-3.1 and other refs (the integration branch, unregistered branches, or other candidates)
criteria.action: report ok for every non-rejected ref in the same report-status response that carries the ng status for the rejected ref

requirements.title: Forwarding in fork-authoritative mode
requirements.rationale: When forwarding is on, a candidate ref's local write must only happen after the fork already has the content, so the hub and fork never disagree because of a hub push.

criteria.condition: PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE is 'origin', PUSH_PATCHES_TO_ORIGIN is "true", and a ref update is a guard candidate under 04-REQ-2
criteria.guard: the per-workspace lock for that one ref is acquired via wslock.TryLock
criteria.action: push refs/heads/<name>:refs/heads/<name> to origin as a non-force push using credentials from workspace.ResolveCloneAuth, before the candidate's local ref is written

criteria.condition: the forward push attempted under 04-REQ-4.1 succeeds
criteria.action: write the candidate ref to the pushed New SHA as part of the same push, report ok for that ref, and release the per-workspace lock
criteria.contract: the client's report-status marks the ref ok; the local ref and the fork's ref both equal the new SHA

criteria.condition: the forward push attempted under 04-REQ-4.1 fails with a non-fast-forward, authentication, network, or any other error
criteria.action: leave the candidate's local ref unchanged and reject it with the per-ref message 'push to origin rejected: <error>', using the forward attempt's own error text
criteria.contract: the client's report-status marks the ref ng with that message; the local ref's SHA is unchanged from before the push

criteria.condition: the per-workspace lock cannot be acquired for a candidate ref under 04-REQ-4.1
criteria.action: reject that ref with the message 'workspace busy; try again' without attempting a forward push
criteria.contract: the client's report-status marks the ref ng with that message; no push to origin occurs for that ref

criteria.action: for any push, process each candidate ref's lock acquisition and forward attempt independently, so a forward failure or a busy lock on one candidate ref never changes the accept/reject outcome of any other ref in the same push
resolve the fork credentials used for every forward push attempt via workspace.ResolveCloneAuth

requirements.title: Mirroring in hub-authoritative mode
requirements.rationale: When the hub is the sole writer, an accepted push should be durably copied to the fork best-effort, without the mirror ever being able to fail the push or the rebuild it triggers.

criteria.condition: PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE is 'hub'
criteria.action: run no pre-receive guard on any ref update, accepting every push exactly as it would without this spec

criteria.condition: PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE is 'hub', PUSH_PATCHES_TO_ORIGIN is "true", and the push has been accepted
criteria.guard: the post-push hook has finished running for the push's actually-updated branches
criteria.action: for every actually-updated branch that also matches a patches row whose status is not 'deleted' and is not the workspace's integration_branch, force-push refs/heads/<name>:refs/heads/<name> to origin using the workspace's fork credentials, attempted in the same goroutine as the post-push hook while holding the per-workspace lock via a non-blocking TryLock

criteria.condition: the non-blocking lock cannot be acquired for a mirror attempt under 04-REQ-5.2
criteria.action: skip that branch's mirror, log the skip, and emit a hub.patch.mirror_failed audit event (EventType 'hub.patch.mirror_failed', ResourceType 'patch', ActorType 'system', Workspace slug, Metadata {branch_name, error}) describing the busy lock
criteria.contract: the audit event is recorded with those fields; the already-accepted push response and any triggered rebuild are unaffected

criteria.condition: the force-push to origin fails for a mirror attempt under 04-REQ-5.2
criteria.action: log the failure and emit a hub.patch.mirror_failed audit event with the same shape, carrying the forward push's error text in Metadata.error
criteria.contract: the audit event is recorded with branch_name and error metadata; the already-accepted push response and any triggered rebuild are unaffected

criteria.action: never allow a mirror attempt's outcome to fail the push response or to block or delay the AUTO_REBUILD_AFTER_PUSH rebuild it may have triggered

requirements.title: Hook registration boundary
requirements.rationale: The pre-receive decision and mirror must reach internal/gitserver the same way the existing post-push hook does, so the git server stays ignorant of carry-patch concepts.

criteria.action: obtain the pre-receive decision function and the mirror function only through package-level registration functions, in the style of RegisterPostPushHook, never by importing internal/carrypatch

invoke the registered pre-receive decision function with only the workspace's db, slug, trunk repo path, and the candidate ref updates, and use only the returned per-branch-name decision, without referencing PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE, PUSH_PATCHES_TO_ORIGIN, or the patches table anywhere in its own source
provide the production implementation of the registered pre-receive decision and mirror functions, reading the workspace row, the variable store, and the patches table itself

requirements.title: Standard workspaces and unrelated pushes are untouched
requirements.rationale: Nothing in this spec may add cost or change behavior for a push that is not a carry_patch patch-branch push.

criteria.condition: a workspace's workspace_mode is not carry_patch
criteria.action: classify every ref update in its pushes as ineligible for guard candidacy without any PUSH_PATCHES_TO_ORIGIN lookup or patches table query, and process the push identically to before this spec
for any push to a carry_patch workspace that contains no guard candidate under 04-REQ-2, apply no refusal, forward, or mirror behavior beyond the classification of 04-REQ-2 itself

requirements.title: Auto-rebuild and audit correctness under partial acceptance
requirements.rationale: Introducing per-ref rejection means the 'branches this push updated' list must now be computed from what was actually written, not from every ref the client attempted.

criteria.action: compute the list of branches a push updated, used by both the post-push hook and the hub.git.push audit event's refs_updated and head_sha metadata, from only the refs actually written by that push, excluding any ref rejected under 04-REQ-3 or 04-REQ-4

criteria.condition: a candidate ref is rejected under 04-REQ-3 or 04-REQ-4
criteria.action: exclude that branch from the branches passed to the post-push hook and from the mirroring of 04-REQ-5, so it cannot trigger a rebuild or a mirror of content the hub never accepted
populate the hub.git.push audit event's refs_updated and head_sha metadata from only the refs actually written by the push, leaving every other field of that event unchanged from before this spec

requirements.title: Logging
requirements.rationale: An operator diagnosing a rejected or failed-forward push needs the acting fields, not a dump of internals.

criteria.condition: a candidate ref is rejected under 04-REQ-3
criteria.action: log at info level the workspace slug, the branch name, and the pushing user's UserID from apikit.GetAuthInfo

criteria.condition: a forward attempt fails under 04-REQ-4
criteria.action: log at warn level the workspace slug, the branch name, the pushing user's UserID from apikit.GetAuthInfo, and the forward attempt's error text
log only the fields listed in 04-REQ-9.1 and 04-REQ-9.2 for a rejection or forward-failure log entry, never a full stack trace or the packfile contents

requirements.title: Documentation
requirements.rationale: An operator or agent must know, before pushing, whether the hub or the fork is the place to push a patch branch.

criteria.action: add a PUSH_PATCHES_TO_ORIGIN subsection to docs/carry_patch_workflow.md's Configuration section, modelled on the existing AUTO_REBUILD_AFTER_PUSH subsection, describing both the origin-mode reject-unless-forwarded meaning and the hub-mode best-effort-mirror meaning

add to docs/carry_patch_workflow.md's How it works / Auto-rebuild on push area a description of the pre-receive refusal and forward and the mirror, including the exact rejection message text 'branch is synced from origin; push to <git_url> instead'

rewrite docs/examples/AGENTS_carry_patch.md's Step 4 ('Push to the Hub') to tell the agent to check PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE before pushing, push to the hub's git server in hub mode, and push directly to the fork's own URL in origin mode unless PUSH_PATCHES_TO_ORIGIN=true

execution_paths.title: Direct push to a fork-synced patch branch is refused

steps.action: runs git push against the hub's git server for patch/foo on a carry_patch workspace with PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE=origin and PUSH_PATCHES_TO_ORIGIN unset
classifies patch/foo as a guard candidate and rejects it with the per-ref message 'branch is synced from origin; push to <git_url> instead'
logs the rejection at info level with the workspace slug, branch name, and pushing user
sees the ng status for patch/foo and pushes directly to the fork's own URL instead

execution_paths.title: Forwarded push to a fork-synced patch branch succeeds and triggers a rebuild

steps.action: runs git push against the hub's git server for patch/foo on a carry_patch workspace with PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE=origin and PUSH_PATCHES_TO_ORIGIN=true
acquires the per-workspace lock and forwards the patch/foo update to origin with a non-force push before writing the local ref
on forward success, writes the local ref to the new SHA, reports ok for patch/foo, and releases the lock
runs asynchronously, matches patch/foo against the patches table, and enqueues an auto-rebuild job

execution_paths.title: Hub-authoritative push is mirrored to the fork best-effort

steps.action: runs git push against the hub's git server for patch/foo on a carry_patch workspace with PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE=hub and PUSH_PATCHES_TO_ORIGIN=true
accepts the push unconditionally and writes the local ref, exactly as before this spec
runs after the post-push hook in the same goroutine and force-pushes patch/foo to origin using the workspace's fork credentials
on failure, logs it and emits a hub.patch.mirror_failed audit event without affecting the already-accepted push or its rebuild

execution_paths.title: A single push partially accepted reports per-ref status and corrected audit metadata

steps.action: runs a single git push updating both the registered patch branch patch/foo and the integration branch main on a carry_patch workspace with PATCH_BRANCH_SOURCE=origin and PUSH_PATCHES_TO_ORIGIN unset
rejects patch/foo with ng and the fork-push message while writing main's ref normally and reporting ok for it
emits a hub.git.push audit event whose refs_updated and head_sha reflect only main, the ref actually written
receives only main in its branch list and does not consider patch/foo for auto-rebuild
